dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcome: Welcome to the PTD Capacity Dashboard. Monitor, predict, and simulate power transformer demand across your network.

cards.predict: Run a single prediction using the trained models to classify or estimate transformer load.
cards.simulate: Run Monte Carlo simulations to estimate overload probability under varying conditions.
cards.health: Check service status, model readiness, and view feature importance rankings.

prediction.title: Run Prediction
prediction.subtitle: Select a model configuration and input feature values to get a prediction.
prediction.profile_help: Select the operational profile (light, regular, or heavy load conditions).
prediction.version_help: Specify a model version to use, or leave empty for the default.
prediction.task_help: Choose classification for categorical output or regression for continuous values.
prediction.model_help: Select the algorithm to use for this prediction.
prediction.features_help: Enter the input values for each feature used by the model.
prediction.no_result: No prediction yet. Configure the model and click Run Prediction.
prediction.map_hint: Click a marker to inspect and apply a PTD
prediction.grid_security_hint: Evolution of the grid safety margin as more chargers are installed on this PTD.

simulation.title: Monte Carlo Simulation
simulation.subtitle: Run probabilistic simulations to assess overload risk under noisy conditions.
simulation.features_help: These values will be used as the baseline, with noise added per iteration.
simulation.iterations_help: Number of simulation runs. Higher values improve accuracy but take longer.
simulation.noise_scale_help: Standard deviation of Gaussian noise added to features each iteration.
simulation.overload_class_help: The class to check probability for (baixo=low, medio=medium, alto=high).
simulation.seed_help: Set a seed for reproducible results, or leave empty for random.
simulation.risk_banner_low: Low overload risk under the simulated conditions.
simulation.risk_banner_medium: Moderate overload risk, monitor this configuration.
simulation.risk_banner_high: High overload risk, review the configuration before installing.
simulation.no_result: No simulation results yet. Configure parameters and click Run Simulation.

health.title: Health & Monitoring
health.subtitle: Monitor system health, model status, and analyze feature importance.
health.reload_help: Reload all models for the selected profile. This may take a moment.
health.feature_importance_help: View which features contribute most to model predictions per algorithm.
health.feature_importance_empty: Select a profile and click Load to view feature importances.
